nodes.label: Presence Server & Mobile Implementation (Issue #72)
nodes.rationale: DB migration 0003 adds online/last_seen columns; server mqtt-bridge subscribes opc/participants/+/presence and persists state (lastSeen is server receive time, restored from retained messages after restart); ACL makes presence world-readable but self-writable only; mobile Contacts shows online dots and relative lastSeen, Me page dot reflects real connection state.
